parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter is valid only if the TagKey.n parameter is not set. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Specify the savings plan instance as the type of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi untag-resources --resource-type instance --all true --resource-id spn-xxxxxx --tag-key codename --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId.1 'spn-xxxxxx' --TagKey.1 codename --ResourceType instance
